data.title: 神裂火织 · 伦敦大教堂雨阶的圣人孤影
data.description: 伦敦圣保罗大教堂巍峨哥特拱柱前，夜雨磅礴。神裂单手握着长鞘巨剑走下湿漉的大理石长阶，雨水冲刷刀镡，圣人悲悯又孤独的心声藏于如秋水般的紫瞳深处。
data.location: massive gothic cathedral stone portico in heavy London night rainstorm with street reflections
data.action: walking down wet cathedral stairs holding sheathed nodachi, rain washing over bare skin, compassionate wistful purple gaze
data.lighting: 大教堂柱廊射灯与湿滑石阶倒影
data.promptProse: Kaori Kanzaki descends the rain-drenched steps of a London cathedral holding her long nodachi, gazing into the deluge with deep, sorrowful Saint compassion.
data.animaCaption: Sheets of rain wash down the stone cathedral steps around her solitary, powerful figure. Soft reflected light reveals her face and the wet cathedral steps.
